entities.summary: Antonios Grigorios Voutsinos was born in Galissas, Syros of Greece. He was ordained a priest of the Assumptionists in 1918, appointed bishop of Syros and Milos, Greece in 1937, Archbishop of Corfu, Zante and Cefalonia in 1947 and Archbishop of Aprus in 1952. He died as archbishop emeritus in 1968.
